name: DefectRAG staff notifications - INACTIVE REVIEW TEMPLATE

parameters.jsCode: const event=$('Validate notification').first().json; const result=$input.first().json; if(!Array.isArray(result.accepted)||!result.accepted.some(email=>String(email).toLowerCase()===event.recipient_email.toLowerCase())||(result.rejected||[]).length) throw new Error('SMTP did not accept the recipient'); return [{json:{event_id:event.event_id,delivered:true}}];
